svg.title: RIM architecture: nine building and street patterns
svg.desc: Original schematic isometric studies of housing, mixed-use streets, apartments, civic buildings and work sites. Proposed design direction, not game screenshots.
svg.text: RIM / ARCHITECTURE THAT MAKES A TOWN
Choose a neighbourhood family. Align buildings to streets. Preserve room for everyday life.
Original schematic design studies • Proposed direction, not game captures • Materials and proportions are illustrative.

g.text: Narrow plots; related roofs; small differences.
Aligned homes; party walls; gardens behind.
Light masonry; dark roofs; vertical openings.
Front paths, hedges and real domestic grounds.
Mixed high street • distinct ground floor
Street edges, entrances and a usable courtyard.
A focal entrance and public space at its base.
Broad doors, repeated sheds and a working yard.
A complete site, canopy, glazing and service space.

svg.text: IMPLEMENTATION ORDER street orientation → footprint / mass → roof → facade rhythm → grounds → materials → selective neon
